symptom: sensors card showed 运动/光照 as 等待数据 / 不可用 even after sensing was enabled
root_cause: the 1 s UI refresh loop (sensorRefresh) was only started by the diagnostics console toggle; enabling sensing from the card dialog started the listeners but never the refresh, so the card kept the snapshot taken before any sample arrived
not_the_cause: the sensors themselves work: SENSOR_CONTEXT passed with 10 checks and SENSOR_LIVE_SAMPLES reported live_motion_samples=41 state=LowMotion accel_available=true gyro_available=true
fix: startSensorRefresh() helper, called when sensing is enabled from the card dialog and from the console toggle; stop path removes the callback
device_after_fix: 运动：低运动（窗口规则估计） / 光照：35.8 Lux · 1 秒前 / 电池温度：28.1 °C
notes: the light sensor is on-change, so its age is displayed instead of pretending it is live
the card text is refreshed every second while monitoring
